questions.en: What is the country that, in 1997, became the last European country to allow divorce?

timeline.labelEn: Ireland's Family Law (Divorce) Act comes into effect after the 1995 referendum
timeline.labelDe: Irlands Scheidungsgesetz tritt nach dem Referendum von 1995 in Kraft

source.title: On this day in 1997, Ireland's controversial divorce laws came into effect – The Irish Post

questions.notes: Dated premise: Malta legalised divorce only in 2011 (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Divorce_law_by_country), so Ireland was the last only until then (Vatican City aside).

questions.en: In which acidic cooking ingredient can you dissolve a pearl?

timeline.labelEn: Pliny the Elder's Natural History tells of Cleopatra dissolving a pearl in vinegar
timeline.labelDe: Plinius der Ältere erzählt in der Naturgeschichte, wie Kleopatra eine Perle in Essig auflöst

questions.notes: Pearls are mostly calcium carbonate, which acetic acid dissolves (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pearl). Lemon juice also works in principle; vinegar is the classic answer.
